name: ticker-transfer
description: Firefox extension: copy stock watchlists between TradingView and broker sites.

scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext lint --ignore-files tests PLAN.md Handoff.md CLAUDE.md AMO-LISTING.md package.json assets
scripts.start: npx --yes web-ext run --start-url https://www.tradingview.com/chart/ --ignore-files tests PLAN.md Handoff.md CLAUDE.md AMO-LISTING.md package.json assets
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files tests PLAN.md Handoff.md CLAUDE.md AMO-LISTING.md package.json assets
